_comment: Optional parts the installer offers on one page, in groups (Yggdrasil's installer shows title, intro and each entry's group, id, name, note). An entry starts chosen when its chosen_if_exists path is on the live system (this medium carries it) or when a USB device from one of its chosen_if_usb vendors (hex ids, /sys/bus/usb/devices/*/idVendor; only a device of its usb_kind when it names one: keyboard, mouse, input = either, printer, gamepad, read from the device's USB interfaces) or exact devices (vendor:product: the fingerprint readers libfprint 1.94.100 supports, the gaming mice of smaller makers libratbag 0.18 supports) is plugged in, or when the computer is what chosen_if_machine says (every key holds: cpu_vendor from /proc/cpuinfo, battery and tablet_switch true or false, absent: a path that must not exist). yggdrasil-install-system: components = ids in /usr/share/labyrinth/components.json; ones on the medium are kept (or removed when not chosen), ones not on it are installed at the new user's first login (labyrinth-first-components, through Agora's password box; they need the internet). The installed system offers the same entries again by itself (Yggdrasil's yggdrasil-device-offers, through labyrinth-packages.conf's devices): once online, when such a device is plugged in, at sign-in, with one click.
title: Optional software
intro: Added from the internet at your first login, unless this medium carries it. Everything here can be added or removed later in Agora.

extras.name: Sarina
extras.note: Your local AI assistant: answers about this computer, fixes, voice. Runs only on this computer; works best with a graphics card with 8 GB or more. The first time you use her she fetches her model server and AI model (several GB).

extras.name: Heimdall
extras.note: Watches this computer for attacks, holds suspicious files and explains what it found. Works on its own; with Sarina it can also explain things in conversation.

extras.name: Logitech
extras.note: Solaar: pairs Unifying and Bolt receivers, battery levels, mouse and keyboard settings.

extras.name: Gaming mice
extras.note: Piper: buttons, DPI and lights for Logitech, SteelSeries, Roccat, ASUS ROG, Glorious and other gaming mice.

extras.name: Razer
extras.note: OpenRazer: lighting, DPI and polling rate for Razer keyboards and mice (builds its driver for your kernels).

extras.name: Corsair keyboards and mice
extras.note: ckb-next: lighting, macros and DPI for Corsair keyboards and mice. (Corsair fan and pump controllers need nothing extra: Settings > Power > Cooling.)

extras.name: Xbox controllers over Bluetooth
extras.note: xpadneo: rumble, battery and the right layout for Xbox and 8BitDo (Xbox mode) controllers over Bluetooth.

extras.name: HP printers and scanners
extras.note: HP's own drivers (HPLIP). Other printers work with the drivers already in the system.

extras.name: Fingerprint reader
extras.note: fprintd: enrol a finger in Settings > Users. Signing in with it stays off until you turn it on there.

extras.name: Intel laptop cooling
extras.note: thermald keeps an Intel laptop under its temperature limits. Not needed on ThinkPads whose firmware runs the cooling.

extras.name: On-screen keyboard
extras.note: wvkbd: shown when the screen is folded into a tablet and no keyboard is plugged in.
